title: 第11章 摘星楼第12章 方青辞的请求
content_zh:
;;
周尘看着炉中三颗晶莹剔透的凝神丹，欣慰一笑：
“这丹道神通果然厉害！”
“没想到，我竟真能在这么短时间内掌握炼丹之术！”
在阴阳塔时光之力的帮助下，最后再配合【丹心玲珑】神通的逆天悟性，让自己从一个从未接触过炼丹的新手，一跃成为了能够炼制三品丹药的炼丹师！
“若是让外界知道，我只用了一个月就达到这个水平，怕是会惊掉下巴吧？”
周尘嘴角微扬。
寻常炼丹师想要达到这个境界，至少需要十年苦修。
而他，却借助阴阳塔和神通之力，将这个时间缩短了数十倍！
“可惜境界限制，不然哪怕四品丹药也不是没有希望。”
以他现在的凝元境修为，炼制三品丹药已是极限。
“若是能突破到真罡境，说不定就能尝试炼制四品丹药了...”
不过虽然暂时无法炼制更高品级的丹药，但以自己现在的水平，已足够解决百草轩的危机。
而且现在如今炼丹师的身份，也足以让自己在天风城站稳脚跟。
但是下一刻，周尘看着空空如也的药材，皱眉道：
“黑虎帮的丹药订单我已经能够炼制，但问题是药材不够用了……”
当初为了练习炼丹术，库房里本就不多的药材几乎被他消耗殆尽。
周尘当即退出阴阳塔，拉开几个药柜抽屉，里面空空如也，只剩下些许药渣。
“没药材了，这下怎么办？”
黑虎帮的订单需要三百瓶壮血丹和两百瓶金疮散，需要消耗海量的基础药材，如今百草轩根本拿不出来。

“无米难为巧妇之炊，即便学会炼丹术也不好搞啊。”
周尘苦笑一声。
“整个天风城的药材渠道，恐怕都已经被林家打过招呼了。”
以林家在天风城的势力和林远山睚眦必报的性格，绝不会给百草轩喘息的机会。
现在去市面上收购药材，根本买不到。
周尘望着街上熙攘的人群，忽然眼前一亮。
??“要不…去摘星楼试一下？”
摘星楼，是青州最负盛名的顶级商行，分号遍布三十六郡上百城。
背后势力神秘莫测，据说其背后有顶级宗门甚至王朝皇室的影子。
摘星楼以其“无所不包，无所不售”而闻名遐迩，只要灵石够多，连天上的星星都能摘下来。
这便是摘星楼名字的由来。
周尘心中有了想法，当即起身离开了百草轩，朝着天风城最繁华的中心区域走去。
不多时，一栋极为气派的九层琉璃宝塔状建筑便出现在他眼前，正是摘星楼。
周尘步入摘星楼，内部空间开阔，琳琅满目。
他无视四周，直接走到售卖药材的区域，找到管事，将写有大量药材名称和数量的清单递了过去：
“管事，这些药材，每样五百份。”
管事接过玉简，神识一扫，眉头顿时皱起：
“青灵草八百株、血灵芝三百朵...公子，这数量可不小，至少需要一千块下品灵石。”
周尘面色平静，毫不在意价格，只是淡淡道：
“灵石，我一块都没有。”

管事闻言，脸上的恭敬瞬间僵住，眉头皱起。
他以为遇到了捣乱之人，正要开口唤护卫。
“你小子是不是在闹事？”
话音刚落，却见周尘不慌不忙地从怀中取出一个小巧的玉瓶，拔开瓶塞。
顿时，一股沁人心脾的奇异丹香弥漫开来，让周围的人都下意识地深吸了一口气。

Zhou Chen looked at the three crystal clear concentration pills in the furnace and smiled happily:
"This alchemy magical power is really powerful!"
"I didn't expect that I could actually master the art of alchemy in such a short period of time!"
With the help of the power of time from the Yin-Yang Tower, and finally with the heaven-defying understanding of the magical power of [Elixir of the Heart], I transformed from a novice who had never been exposed to alchemy to an alchemist capable of refining third-grade elixirs!
"If the outside world knew that it only took me a month to reach this level, their jaws would be shocked, right?"
Zhou Chen's mouth raised slightly.
For ordinary alchemists to reach this level, they need at least ten years of hard training.
But he, with the help of the Yin-Yang Tower and magical powers, shortened this time dozens of times!
"It's a pity that the realm is limited, otherwise even fourth-grade elixirs are not without hope."
With his current cultivation level in the Yuan Condensation Realm, refining third-grade elixirs is already the limit.
"If we can break through to the True Gang Realm, maybe we can try to refine fourth-grade elixirs..."
However, although he is temporarily unable to refine higher-grade elixirs, his current level is enough to resolve Baicao Xuan's crisis.
Moreover, his current status as an alchemist is enough for him to gain a foothold in Tianfeng City.
But the next moment, Zhou Chen looked at the empty medicinal materials and frowned:
"I have been able to refine the elixir order from the Black Tiger Gang, but the problem is that there are not enough medicinal materials..."
In order to practice alchemy, he almost consumed all the few medicinal materials in the warehouse.
Zhou Chen immediately exited the Yin Yang Tower and opened several medicine cabinet drawers. They were empty except for some medicine residue.
"We have no medicinal materials, what should we do now?"
The Black Tiger Gang's order requires 300 bottles of blood-strengthening pills and 200 bottles of Jinshang powder, which requires a large amount of basic medicinal materials, and now Baicao Xuan cannot get them at all.
"It's hard for a clever woman to cook without rice, even if she learns alchemy, it's still not easy."
Zhou Chen smiled bitterly.
"I'm afraid the entire medicinal material channels in Tianfeng City have already been contacted by the Lin family."
With the power of the Lin family in Tianfeng City and Lin Yuanshan's vengeful character, Baicao Xuan would never be given a chance to breathe.
Now when I go to the market to buy medicinal materials, I can’t find them at all.
Zhou Chen looked at the bustling crowd on the street, and suddenly his eyes lit up.
??"Why don't you... go to Zhaixing Tower and give it a try?"
Zhaixinglou is the most prestigious top-level trading house in Qingzhou, with branches spread over hundreds of cities in thirty-six counties.
The forces behind it are mysterious and unpredictable. It is said that there are shadows of top sects and even dynasty royal families behind it.
Zhaixinglou is famous for its "everything is included and everything is sold". As long as there are enough spiritual stones, even the stars in the sky can be picked.
This is the origin of the name of Zhaixinglou.
Zhou Chen had an idea in his mind, and immediately stood up and left Baicaoxuan, heading towards the most prosperous central area of ​​Tianfeng City.
Not long after, an extremely majestic nine-story glazed pagoda-like building appeared in front of him, which was the Star Reaching Tower.
Zhou Chen stepped into the Star Reaching Building. The interior space was wide and dazzling.
He ignored his surroundings, walked directly to the area where medicinal materials were sold, found the steward, and handed over a list with a large number of names and quantities of medicinal materials:
"Steward, these medicinal materials, five hundred copies each."
The steward took the jade slip, glanced at it with his consciousness, and frowned:
"Eight hundred green spirit grasses and three hundred blood lingzhi plants... Master, this is not a small quantity. It requires at least a thousand low-grade spirit stones."
Zhou Chen looked calm and didn't care about the price. He just said lightly:
"I don't have any spiritual stones."
When the steward heard this, the respect on his face instantly froze and his brows furrowed.
He thought he had encountered someone causing trouble, and was about to call the guards.
"Are you kid making trouble?"
As soon as he finished speaking, Zhou Chen calmly took out a small jade bottle from his arms and uncorked it.
Suddenly, a refreshing and strange elixir fragrance filled the air, making everyone around him take a deep breath subconsciously.
